candidates.title: Magical Girl Raising Project
candidates.reason: Across the complete 12-episode 2016 anime, a mobile game creates sixteen magical girls with distinct supernatural abilities, then its mascot announces a weekly Magical Candy elimination contest. Discovering that losing one's status means death transforms the contest into a violent survival game: participants form alliances, conceal intentions, exploit magical powers, betray rivals and learn that the rules reward lethal manipulation. Hidden organizer motives, tactical counters, abrupt reversals, foreshadowing and frequent character deaths create a dark suspenseful contrast with the cute magical-girl designs. The different powers support varied confrontations, but the protagonist Snow White is often passive and does not undergo sustained on-screen training or systematic power growth; the magical system and wider world are only lightly explained. Whole-season reviews disagree about whether the twists succeed, while criticizing a crowded sixteen-person cast, repetitive pre-death flashbacks, uneven character development, occasionally inconsistent animation, superficial worldbuilding and exploitative or gratuitous cruelty. The candy-collection mechanics also lose importance as killings increase. The evidence is restricted to the 2016 television season, not later light-novel arcs or planned adaptations.
